title.en: Fable 29 — The Wind and the Sun

sentences.en: The wind and the sun quarrelled.
The wind said: I am stronger.
The sun said: no, I am stronger.
And below them, on the road, a man walking.
Wearing a coat.
The sun said: let us try.

sentences.ar: اللي بيشلح المعطف عن الرجل، هو الأقوى.
sentences.en: Whoever gets the coat off the man is the stronger.
The wind said: easy.
And blew.

sentences.en: The wind grew tired.
And said: your turn.
And the sun came out from behind the clouds.

sentences.en: And warmed.
Little by little.
And the man undid the buttons.
And the sun warmed more.
And the man sweated.
And wiped his brow.
And took off the coat.
And put it over his shoulder.
And went on his way.
